The '''Star Fortress''' over [[Voss]] was one of many dozens, if not hundreds of [[Star Fortress]]es deployed by Emperor [[Arcann]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] to enforce treaties on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as well as possible uprisings on worlds subjugated during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. It was commanded by [[Exarch]] [[Andur Melor]] and protected by multiple [[Skytrooper]]s and [[Knights of Zakuul]]. The [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] saw the [[Star Fortress]] as a source of the disease that affected their young, old and weak. In [[3631 BBY]], a Gormak warrior [[Rokuss]] teamed up with [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] to take down the Star Fortress. Together they assembled a strike team that assaulted and destroyed the [[Voss shield bunker]] protecting the Star Fortress before regrouping on the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]]. From there, [[Theron Shan]] and [[Miot Dengd]] assisted the Commander in infiltrating the Star Fortress. After fighting their way through multiple levels of the station, the Commander was able to reach the [[Sun Generator]] room and engage the Exarch directly. During the fierce fighting, safety features of the Sun Generator were disabled and Exarch Andur Melor was killed. The Commander barely managed to escape on the shuttle before the Sun Generator overloaded, vaporizing the entire Star Fortress and all of its remaining personnel.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Voss Star Fortress appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as one of six Star Fortresses that can be assaulted and destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />
